title: Cloning of amplified miRNA target sites into 3'-UTR of luciferase reporter vector.
protocol: Clone the oligonucleotide duplex with a 43 nt Hox-A11 target sequence for miR-181a into Sac I/Xba I sites of pISO vector.
Sequence the cloned plasmid and use it for further cloning.
Linearize the target plasmid using SacI/SpeI restriction enzymes.
Cut the target plasmid with SacI/XbaI to obtain a fragment containing one target site.
Ligate the gel-purified fragment into linearized plasmid.
Linearize the 2 targets plasmid using SacI/SpeI restriction enzymes.
Cut the SacI/XbaI fragment from the 2 targets plasmid, containing two target sites.
Ligate the gel-purified fragment into linearized 2 targets plasmid.
